dedupe_keys.name: cbs statline 37478hvv monthly aviation figures for dutch airports of national importance

description: Statistics Netherlands publishes monthly and yearly figures for the Dutch airports of national importance (Amsterdam Airport Schiphol, Rotterdam The Hague, Eindhoven, Maastricht Aachen and Groningen Eelde, plus their total) in StatLine table 37478hvv. It gives aircraft movements (overland and local), commercial flights by scheduled and non-scheduled service and by arrival and departure, passengers the same way, freight and mail in tonnes loaded and unloaded, and passengers, freight and mail by origin and destination region (EU, other Europe and world regions from North Africa to Oceania). Yearly figures start in 1997 and monthly ones in January 1999; the table runs to July 2026 and was last modified on 28 August 2026, with figures up to 2024 final. It is online free through the StatLine viewer and the CBS OData API, available as CSV or JSON, under CC BY 4.0 with CBS named as the source. Coverage is national at airport level. Caveats: the regional breakdown is coarse, there are no airport pairs or airlines, and recent months are provisional. The table gives demand and freight flows for airport capacity and network models, and relates to the AEOLUS aviation forecasting model and OpenFlights catalogued here.
